svg.title: Vyleesi (PT-141) trials: a small edge, and many quit early
svg.desc: Vyleesi (PT-141) trials: a small edge, and many quit early. Desire score rose 1.2+ points: 25% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 17% with placebo. Distress score fell 1+ point: 35% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 31% with placebo. Stopped early: Study 1: 40% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 13% with placebo. Stopped early: Study 2: 39% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 25% with placebo. Stopped because of side effects: 18% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 2% with placebo.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
